z-m-07-09.title: Imisa rootiyo digir casaan ah ayaa makhaayaddu dubi lahayd Isniinta xigta?
z-m-07-09.topic: Qiyaasidda waxa horey u yaal diiwaannada iibka (maaraynta qiime xad-dhaaf ah)
z-m-07-09.goal: Ogow marka wax horey loo qiyaaso diiwaannada, sida loo maareeyo qiime xad-dhaaf ah ay ku xidhan tahay sababta, oo dib u eeg qiyaastaada iyo intee le'eg ayaad ku kalsoon tahay macluumaad cusub, adigoo ku qoraya qoraal.
z-m-07-09.material: Makhaayad xaafadeed ayaa subax kasta dubta rootiyada digirka casaanka ah ee la iibin doono maalintaas. Haddii ay dubto aad u badan, qaar baa hadhaya, haddii ay dubto aad u yar na, way yaraanaysaa. Mulkiiluhu wuxuu rabaa inuu go'aamiyo imisa rootiyo digir casaan ah ayuu dubi lahaa Isniinta xigta isagoo eegaya diiwaannada iibka toddobaadkii hore. Toddobaadkii hore dukaanku wuu furnaa maalin kasta laga bilaabo Isniin ilaa Jimce.
z-m-07-09.thinking.1: Maamul qiime xad-dhaaf ah adigoo baaraya sababtiisa
z-m-07-09.thinking.2: Ilaali ama dib u eeg xukunkaaga macluumaad cusub
z-m-07-09.thinking.3: Kala saar xaaladaha qiyaastaadu beddeli karto
z-m-07-09.prereq.0: Akhrinta tirooyin shaxaha ama diiwaannada iyo kala saaridda tirooyinka isku dhow iyo qiimayaasha xad-dhaafka ah (heerka Fasalka 3aad)
z-m-07-09.s.s1.prompt: Aan qiyaasno imisa la dubo Isniinta xigta anagoo si tartiib tartiib ah u barayna diiwaannada iibka. Tallaabo kasta, dooro waxa aad u malaynayso inuu ugu habboon yahay.
z-m-07-09.s.s1.hint.0: Kala horreyn u qor tirooyinka iibka ee maalmaha ilaa hadda la yaqaan, oo calaamadee tirooyinka midba midka kale u dhow iyo tirooyinka kala fog.
z-m-07-09.s.s1.hint.1: Haddii tiro kala fogaata jirto, ka fikir hab lagu hubiyo haddii wax kale ka dhacay maalintaas.
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.0.info: Isniinta waxay iibiyeen 12, Salaasada 14, Arbacada na 13.
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.0.ask: Qiyaastii imisa rootiyo digir casaan ah ayaa fiicnaan lahaa in la dubo Isniinta xigta?
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.0.after: Saddexda maalmood waa isku mid 12 ilaa 14, sidaa darteed qiyaastii 13, ama wax yar si ballaaran u qaadis qiyaastii 14, waa macquul. Maadaama aan aragnay 3 maalmood oo keliya, 'Waxaan rabaa inaan wax yar sii daawado' ayaa la tixgelin karaa, laakiin xataa diiwaannada hadda jira waxay inagu oggolaanayaan inaan sheegno cabbir qiyaas ah.
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Tani aad bay uga badan tahay maalinta ugu iibka badan saddexda maalmood. Eeg haddii diiwaannadu bixiyaan sabab lagu kordhiyo intaas.
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Kani waa xukun doortay dhexda sababtoo ah iibka saddexda maalmood waa isku dhow, 12 ilaa 14.
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Kani waa xukun oggolaaday xoogaa dheeraad ah sababtoo ah ka yaraanshuhu waa walaac ka weyn hadhaaga.
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Waxaan aragnay 3 maalmood oo keliya sidaa darteed ma go'aamin karno
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Kani waa dabeecad taxaddar leh. Weli, eegista sida tirooyinka saddexda maalmood u dhow yihiin midba midka kale waxay bixin kartaa tilmaan.
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.1.info: Khamiista waxay iibiyeen 31. Mulkiiluhu weli ma ogin sababta aad u badan oo loo iibiyey Khamiista.
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.1.ask: Sidee ayuu fikirkaaga ku saabsan tirada la dubayo Isniinta xigta u beddelmaa?
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.1.after: Sababta 31 u soo baxday la ogaan la'aanteed, labadaba 'ilaali qiyaastii 13 oo hel sababta' iyo 'diyaari wax yar si ballaaran qiyaastii 17 ilaa 18' waa macquul. Waxay isku mid yihiin inay hore tahay in 31 sida ay tahay lagu aamino ama aan sabab la'aan la tirtirin.
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.1.o.a: U kordhi ku dhow 31. Waa diiwaanka ugu dambeeya
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ka fikir haddii ugu dambeynta ay tahay sabab lagu aamino 31. Intee le'eg ayay ka duwan tahay tirooyinka saddexda maalmood ee kale?
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Diiwaanka Khamiista waa khalad, sidaa darteed tirtir
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Caddayn ah in diiwaanku khalad yahay ma jirto. Way fiicantahay in la hubiyo sababta ay sare u ahayd halkii aan caddayn la'aan la tirtiri lahaa.
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Ilaali qiyaastii ugu horreysay, laakiin hel sababta Khamiistu sare u ahayd
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Kani waa xukun aan isla markiiba aaminin ama tirtirin qiimaha fog, laakiin isku dayaya inuu helo sababta.
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Isku dar dhammaan afarta maalmood oo u qaybi 4, oo dub qiyaastii 17 ilaa 18
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Qiime fog sidoo kale waa diiwaan, sidaa darteed waad ku darta, laakiin qiimahaasi celceliska ayuu kor u jiidaa. Weli ma ogin haddii Isniinta xigtaa ay noqon doonto maalin sida Khamiista.
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.2.info: Jimcaha waxay iibiyeen 13. Waxaana ogaanay in Khamiista ay ka dhacday dhacdo hal mar ah, carwo, beerta u dhow. Isniinta xigta wax dhacdo ah agtiisa ma jirto.
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.2.ask: Hadda, qiyaastii imisa ayaa fiicnaan lahaa in la dubo Isniinta xigta?
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.2.after: Khamiistu waxay ahayd maalin badan oo la iibiyey dhacdo hal mar ah awgeed, Isniinta xigta na dhacdo ma jirto, sidaa darteed afarta maalmood ee kale (12, 14, 13, 13) ayaa tilmaan ka fiican. Qiyaastii 13, ama qiyaastii 15 oo yar oo meel banaan leh, waa macquul. Waxa kala duwan waa in xataa arday ilaaliyey qiyaastii ugu horreysay ilaa dhammaadka ayuu sii hubsaday ka dib markuu ogaaday sababta.
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Waxaa la yiri Isniinta xigta dhacdo ma jirto. Ka fikir haddii sababta 31 u soo baxday ay mar kale dhici doonto.
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Sidee u ka tarjumay xisaabinta in Khamiistu aysan ahayn maalin caadi ah laakiin maalin dhacdo leh?
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Haddii aad ka reebto Khamiista, marka dhacdo jirtay, maalmaha kale waa isku mid 12 ilaa 14. Kani waa xukun doortay dhexda kuwaas.
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Kani waa xukun oggolaaday meel yar oo ku salaysan qiyaastii 13.
z-m-07-09.s.s1.reflect: Haddii aad ku darto 31 ee Khamiista xisaabinta ama aad ka reebto, qiyaastaadu aad ayay u beddelantaa. Sheeg sababta aad isla tirada si kala duwan ugu macaamishay ka hor iyo ka dib ogaanshaha sababta. Sidoo kale ka fikir haddii wax hal mar ah mar kale dhici karaan.
z-m-07-09.s.s2.prompt: Qor qoraal loo diro mulkiilaha. Qor tirada la dubo Isniinta xigta, sababta aad ku go'aamisay, iyo hal xaalad oo tiradaasi beddeli karto.
z-m-07-09.s.s2.hint.0: Mar kale akhri tirooyinka maalmaha u dhow Isniinta oo hel maalinta ugu eg.
z-m-07-09.s.s2.hint.1: Ka fikir hal maalin oo tirada beddeli karto (dhacdo, cimilada).
z-m-07-09.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma mar kale hubisay in tirada aad dooratay ay u dhow tahay tirooyinka diiwaannada?
z-m-07-09.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma qortay sida aad u maamushay 31 ee Khamiista (ma ku dartay mise waad ka reebtay) iyo sababta?
z-m-07-09.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma 'xaaladda beddeli karta' ee aad qortay runtii waa mid beddeli karta tirada?
z-m-07-09.s.s2.model.0: Waxaan jeclaan lahaa inaan dubo qiyaastii 13. Isniin, Salaasa, Arbaco, iyo Jimce waxay iibiyeen 12 ilaa 14, 31 ee Khamiista na waxay ahayd carwada awgeed. Haddii dhacdo ay jirto agtiisa Isniinta sidoo kale, waa inaad wax badan dubtaa.
z-m-07-09.s.s2.model.1: Waxaan dubi doonaa qiyaastii 15. Caadi ahaan qiyaastii 13 ayaa la iibiyaa, sidaa darteed waxaan ku daray 2 si ay u noqoto xoogaa dheeraad ah, 31 ee Khamiista na waan ka reebay sababtoo ah waxay ahayd dhacdo hal mar ah awgeed. Haddii roob da'o, wax yar ayaa la iibin karaa.
z-m-07-09.s.s2.modelNote.1: Kani waa qoraal xaaladda leh meel yar oo dheeraad ah.

z-m-07-01.title: Wax-soo-saarka lambar laba-lambar ah iyo lambar hal-lambar ah ma had iyo jeer waa lambar saddex-lambar ah?
z-m-07-01.topic: Go'aaminta imisa lambar ayuu wax-soo-saarka (lambar laba-lambar ah)×(lambar hal-lambar ah) leeyahay
z-m-07-01.goal: Ogow in dhowr tusaale oo dhufasho oo sax ah aysan ka dhigin 'had iyo jeer,' samee tusaalayaashaada halka wax-soo-saarka lambar laba-lambar ah iyo lambar hal-lambar ah uu yahay lambar laba-lambar ah, oo sheeg goorta uu noqdo lambar saddex-lambar ah.
z-m-07-01.material:
Doyun wuxuu xalliyay dhibaatooyin dhufasho wuxuuna yiri tan.
'37×4=148, 52×6=312, 78×9=702. Wax-soo-saarka lambar laba-lambar ah iyo lambar hal-lambar ah had iyo jeer waa lambar saddex-lambar ah!'
(Halkan lambarka laba-lambarka ah waa lambar ka bilaabma 10 ilaa 99, lambarka hal-lambarka ahna waa lambar ka bilaabma 2 ilaa 9. 37×4 waxaa loo akhriyaa 'soddon iyo toddoba jeer afar'.)
z-m-07-01.thinking.0: Baar haddii tusaalayaal badan oo sax ah ay dammaanad qaadaan 'had iyo jeer'
z-m-07-01.thinking.1: Adigu samee tusaalayaal lid ku ah
z-m-07-01.thinking.2: Sheeg halbeegga kala saara goorta ay ku sax tahay iyo goorta aysan sax ahayn
z-m-07-01.prereq.0: Akhri tibaaxaha dhufashada ee lambar laba-lambar ah iyo lambar hal-lambar ah oo hel qiimaha (heerka Fasalka 3aad)
z-m-07-01.prereq.1: Ogow in 100 uu yahay lambarka saddex-lambarka ah ee ugu horreeya
z-m-07-01.s.s1.prompt: Maxaad ka fikirtaa waxa Doyun yiri? Ku xukun xadka go'an: lambarrada laba-lambarka ah waa 10 ilaa 99 lambarrada hal-lambarka ahna waa 2 ilaa 9.
z-m-07-01.s.s1.hint.0: Qor isbarbar lambarrada Doyun tijaabiyay, 37, 52, iyo 78, iyo lambarrada uu ku dhufay, 4, 6, iyo 9, oo hel xaaladaha uu tijaabin.
z-m-07-01.s.s1.hint.1: Ku dhufo labada lambar ee ugu yar xadka dhexdiisa iyo labada lambar ee ugu weyn, oo qiyaas qiyaastii xadka wax-soo-saarka ku jiro.
z-m-07-01.s.s1.o.a: Waxaad ku dhufatay lambar hal-lambar ah, sidaas darteed wax-soo-saarku had iyo jeer waa lambar laba-lambar ah
z-m-07-01.s.s1.r.a: Lambar laba-lambar ah oo noqda isbarbar hal-lambar ah ma ka dhigto wax-soo-saarka lambar laba-lambar ah. Eeg imisa lambar ayuu wax-soo-saarka 78×9, kan Doyun bixiyay, leeyahay.
z-m-07-01.s.s1.o.b: Haddii lambarka hal-lambarka ahi yahay 9, wax-soo-saarku had iyo jeer waa lambar saddex-lambar ah
z-m-07-01.s.s1.r.b: Xataa ku dhufashada 9 waxay bixin kartaa lambar laba-lambar ah. Eeg waxa wax-soo-saarka 10×9 yahay.
z-m-07-01.s.s1.o.c: Saddexda tusaale dhammaantood waa sax, sidaas darteed Doyun waa sax
z-m-07-01.s.s1.r.c: Tusaale sax ah waa wax ka duwan "had iyo jeer" sax ah. Waxaad u baahan tahay inaad eegto haddii ay jiraan xaalado aan weli la tijaabin.
z-m-07-01.s.s1.o.d: Mararka qaarkood waa lambar saddex-lambar ah mararka qaarkoodna lambar laba-lambar ah
z-m-07-01.s.s1.r.d: Tani waa fikirka ah in tirada lambarrada wax-soo-saarku ay isbeddeli karto iyadoo ku xiran cabbirrada labada lambar ee la dhufanayo. Way sii caddaataa haddii aad samayso tusaalayaal oo aad hubiso.
z-m-07-01.s.s1.explain: Wax-soo-saarka ugu yar xadka dhexdiisa waa 10×2=20 kan ugu weyn-na waa 99×9=891. Sidaas darteed wax-soo-saarku wuxuu noqon karaa lambar laba-lambar ah ama saddex-lambar ah, mana noqon karo lambar afar-lambar ah.
z-m-07-01.s.s2.prompt: Samee laba tusaale oo wax-soo-saarro kala duwan leh oo muujinaya hadalka Doyun inuu khaldan yahay. Dooro lambar laba-lambar ah a (10 ilaa 99) iyo lambar hal-lambar ah b (2 ilaa 9) si wax-soo-saarku uu u noqdo mid aan ahayn lambar saddex-lambar ah.
z-m-07-01.s.s2.hint.0: Marka hore dooro lambarro yar oo dhufo, oo hubi imisa lambar ayuu wax-soo-saarku leeyahay.
z-m-07-01.s.s2.hint.1: Dooro hal a, ka dibna u beddel b 2, 3, 4, ... oo hel meesha wax-soo-saarku marka ugu horreysa noqdo lambar saddex-lambar ah.
z-m-07-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Ka dhig a tiro dabiici ah oo ka bilaabma 10 ilaa 99.
z-m-07-01.s.s2.ok.c2: b waa lambar hal-lambar ah (2 ilaa 9).
z-m-07-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Ka dhig b tiro dabiici ah oo ka bilaabma 2 ilaa 9.
z-m-07-01.s.s2.ok.c3: Wax-soo-saarku wuu ka yar yahay 100, sidaas darteed ma aha lambar saddex-lambar ah. Hadalka Doyun wuu jabay.
z-m-07-01.s.s2.fail.c3: Wax-soo-saarku waa lambar saddex-lambar ah ama ka badan. Beddel a ama b si wax-soo-saarku u yaraado.
z-m-07-01.s.s2.explain: Tusaale ahaan, 12×3=36, 20×4=80, iyo 45×2=90 dhammaantood waa lambarro laba-lambar ah. 50×2=100 waa bilowga lambarrada saddex-lambarka ah, sidaas darteed ma aha tusaale. Xataa hal tusaale oo lid ku ah ayaa jebiya 'had iyo jeer.'
z-m-07-01.s.s3.prompt: Maxaad jeclaan lahayd inaad Doyun u sheegto? Adoo isticmaalaya tusaalayaasha aad hadda samaysay, qor sababta uu u khaldan yahay, oo sidoo kale qor goorta wax-soo-saarku noqdo lambar saddex-lambar ah.
z-m-07-01.s.s3.hint.0: Waxaad dib u isticmaali kartaa tibaaxaha dhufashada ee tusaalayaasha aad marka hore samaysay sida ay yihiin.
z-m-07-01.s.s3.hint.1: Ka fikir lambarka noqda xadka u dhexeeya lambarrada laba-lambarka ah iyo saddex-lambarka ah.
z-m-07-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Tusaalahaaga, ma mar kale xisaabisay si aad u hubiso in wax-soo-saarka lambarka laba-lambarka ah iyo lambarka hal-lambarka ah uu runtii yahay lambar laba-lambar ah?
z-m-07-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma qortay adoo ogaanaya in hal tusaale uu ku filan yahay si loo jebiyo 'had iyo jeer'?
z-m-07-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ma sheegtay goorta uu noqdo lambar saddex-lambar ah adoo isticmaalaya lambarro (tusaale, 99×9) ama halbeeg (100 ama ka badan)?
z-m-07-01.s.s3.model.0: Waxa Doyun yiri ma ahan mid had iyo jeer sax ah. Waxaa jira xaalado uu yahay lambar laba-lambar ah, sida 12×3=36. Haddii labada lambar ay weyn yihiin oo wax-soo-saarku dhaafo 100, wuxuu noqdaa lambar saddex-lambar ah.
z-m-07-01.s.s3.model.1: Maya. 20×4=80 waa lambar laba-lambar ah. Marka labada lambar ee la dhufanayo ay sii weynaadaan, wax-soo-saarku wuu sii weynaadaa, sidaas darteed wuxuu noqon karaa lambar saddex-lambar ah sida 99×9=891.
z-m-07-01.s.s3.modelNote.1: Jawaab sheegaysa 'marka lambarradu sii weynaadaan' halkii halbeegga '100 ama ka badan' sidoo kale waa fiican tahay.

z-m-07-10.s.s3.model.0: Seoha, 7 ka mid ah 10 waxay macnaheedu noqon kartaa casaan badan ayaa jira. Laakiin Haram wuxuu helay 4, sidaa darteed xataa isla bac farqi intaas le'eg ayaa dhici kara. Aan labadeenba kordhino tirada soo saaridda oo isku darno.
z-m-07-10.s.s3.model.1: Weli ma gunaanan karno inay kala duwan yihiin. Waxaan tijaabinnay 10 soo saar oo keliya mid walba, sidaa darteed haddii aan soo saarno wax badan oo aan isbarbar dhigno imisa jeer casaan soo baxay, waxaan si fiican u ogaan karnaa.
z-m-07-10.s.s3.modelNote.1: Kani waa kiis aan si toos ah u sheegin natiijada Seoha laakiin aan gunaanad gaarin oo sharaxay hab.
z-m-07-10.s.s3.model.2: Xataa isla bac, tani way ka timaadi kartaa kadis. Aan mid walba soo saarno wax badan oo aan isbarbar dhigno natiijooyinka la isku daray (7 jeer, 4 jeer).
